messages:
Maya: i'm composing the release notes for the upcoming docs push. focal points: adaptive routing announcement, migration steps for pinned variants, and a Known Issues short-list. need.py/ts/go snippets updated, a 3-step migration checklist, and one-liner repro for the p99 spike.
Jon: can take python + curl. please post the PR so i can comment.
Maya: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4901 on branch release/adaptive-routing-updates.
Priya: i'll update TS & Go. heads up: param `retry_policy` -> `fallback_policy` and shape changed to an object. will rewrite examples to reflect the dict/object form.
Theo: found a couple of stale cross-links in the migration doc pointing to old anchors. i'll push a tiny redirect commit in the same PR.
Jon: fixed python snippet to show object form, e.g. client.generate(... fallback_policy={"type":"model_variant","priority":["fast","cheap"]}). also swapped raw github paths for docs permalinks to reduce rot.
Maya: nice. can someone draft the Known Issues one-liner with repro steps? suggested text: "p99 latency can spike under mixed long+short bursts; repro: stage, send one long context then N parallel shorts." need it concise for the release notes.
Priya: added TS repro steps inline in the PR comments and a short cURL example.
Theo: added a small note for Dedicated customers: reserved pools may affect fallback ordering; included in migration notes.
docs-bot: Staging preview ready for PR #4901. Please verify snippets render and anchors resolve.
Jon: i'll run the python sample on staging runtime tomorrow and report latency/token counts.
Maya: timeline: merge target EOD tomorrow. please add approvals in PR once QA green. i'll schedule site publish and a short slack announcement post-merge.
Priya: nit: link text for "model variants" now points to the model catalog page instead of internal heuristics page. pushed fix.
Theo: migration checklist drafted (3 steps) and added to the bottom of the migration guide for pinned variants.
Jon: approved after QA check.
Priya: approved.
Maya: thanks team ":tada:" will merge after final QA signal.
